sourceText: Selected request: 先本机 Docker probe。跑 2-5 rows，验证：Codex CLI 能在容器里跑；两个账户能分 shard；输入没有污染；output/receipt 格式正确；contamination scan 能挡住问题。User then requested: 那就本机吧，开始验证吧。
normalizedOutcome: Run a bounded local Docker probe for Cell 06 A2prime with two to five rows or equivalent smoke rows: prove Codex CLI container execution for available auth, represent account shard separation without faking unavailable credentials, verify sterile input packaging, validate receipt/output format, and prove contamination scan and merge checks reject bad rows.
acceptanceClaim: B-8092 is accepted when the worktree contains local Docker probe tooling plus probe evidence showing image/Codex CLI smoke, sterile input manifest, probe receipt rows, contamination negative controls, and merge validation results, without running full Cell06 or upgrading paper claims.
